summary: auth login --chrome decrypts Chrome's cookie database natively, including Linux profiles with no keyring and no sqlite3 CLI, with the external tool chain kept as a fallback.
reason: Chrome keeps values in encrypted_value. On Linux the basic password store is used when libsecret is absent. Listing only Default/Profile directories missed symlink profiles and google-chrome-headless, so login fell through to pycookiecheat.
